use default
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.Math
use System.Random

let random = Random(12)

class PET(name: string) is
    age: int public
    hunger: int public
    happiness: int public
    poops: int public
    sick: bool public
    cause_of_death: string? public

    init(..) is
        happiness = 5
    si

    alive: bool => !cause_of_death?

    face: string =>
        if !alive then "(x_x)"
        elif sick then "(>_<)"
        elif hunger > 6 \/ happiness < 3 then "(;_;)"
        else "(^_^)"
        fi

    show() is
        write_line(
            "{face} {name}, age {age}: "
            "hunger {hunger}/10, happiness {happiness}/10")

        if poops > 0 then
            let droppings = "".pad_right(poops, '@')
            write_line("      {droppings} needs cleaning up")
        fi

        if sick then
            write_line("      {name} is sick")
        fi
    si

    pass_an_hour() is
        age = age + 1
        hunger = Math.min(hunger + 1, 10)

        if age % 3 == 0 then
            happiness = happiness - 1
        fi

        if random.next(3) == 0 then
            poops = poops + 1
        fi

        sick = sick \/ poops >= 4

        cause_of_death =
            if hunger >= 10 then "starved"
            elif happiness <= 0 then "died of loneliness"
            elif sick /\ random.next(6) == 0 then "died of its illness"
            elif age >= 24 then "died peacefully of old age"
            else null
            fi
    si
si

write_line("what will you call your pet?")

write_line("commands: feed, play, clean, cure, wait")

    if !line? then
        break
    fi

    when "feed" then
        pet.hunger = Math.max(pet.hunger - 4, 0)
        write_line("{pet.name} eats")
    when "play" then
        let hand = if random.next(2) == 0 then "left" else "right" fi
        write_line("{pet.name} hid a treat: left or right?")

        let guess = read_line() ?? ""
        write_line("> {guess}")

        if guess.trim() =~ hand then
            pet.happiness = Math.min(pet.happiness + 3, 10)
            write_line("found it! {pet.name} is delighted")
        else
            pet.happiness = Math.min(pet.happiness + 1, 10)
            write_line("it was in the {hand} hand")
            write_line("{pet.name} enjoyed the game anyway")
        fi
    when "clean" then
        pet.poops = 0
        write_line("all clean")
    when "cure" then
        if pet.poops > 0 then
            write_line("clean up first, or {pet.name} will get sick again")
        else
            pet.sick = false
            write_line("{pet.name} feels better")
        fi
    when "wait" then
        write_line("time passes")
    else
        write_line("commands: feed, play, clean, cure, wait")
        continue
    esac

    pet.pass_an_hour()
    pet.show()
od

if let cause = pet.cause_of_death then
    write_line("{pet.name} {cause} at age {pet.age}")
fi
